input.subject: Heads up before it goes live Monday — Tribeca 2BR
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

Wanted to give you a heads up before it goes live — hitting the market this Monday: 88 Leonard St #4A, Tribeca, 2BR/2BA, $2.6M.

Not active yet, previews start Monday morning. If you have a buyer who wants a first look before it's officially listed, reply today and I'll get you in early.

More photos to come once we launch.

Best,
Alyssa
